title: Generic scalar monoidality in the finite-Hom interface
statement: For commutative rings A,B in Type (u+1), a unital homomorphism phi:A→B and a scheme T in universe u, the fixed scalar-extension functor with its actual published tensor and unit comparisons and Koszul isomorphisms [def-pur-exceptional-coefficient-normalizations, def-sf-etale-finite-coefficient-hom-arrow] satisfies FiniteHomDomainMonoidal [def-coef-finite-hom-monoidal-data]. The same unit and tensor comparisons satisfy their all-complex UnitNormalization and TensorNormalization equations.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0FPT; identity geometric morphism with changed constant coefficients; extracted monoidality step of lem-coef-finite-hom-domain-calculus.

proof.text: Use the proved generic scalar CoreMonoidal structure and its identified unit, tensorators and braiding square. Convert its unit and tensor equalities into heterogeneous equalities; take the actual Koszul isomorphisms for the existential braiding witnesses. Their heterogeneous identifications are reflexive. Pair the result with the proved scalar comparison normalization theorem. All categorical sharing is performed at generic rings before finite coefficient specialization.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteHomScalar_monoidal
    (A B : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (φ : A →+* B) (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    FiniteHomDomainMonoidal (Etale.scalarExtension φ T)
      (fun U V ↦ (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.tensorIso φ T).app (U, V))
      (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso φ T)
      (finiteHomKoszulIso (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
      (finiteHomKoszulIso (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B))) ∧
    Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.UnitNormalization φ T
      (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso φ T) ∧
    Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.TensorNormalization φ T
      (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.tensorIso φ T)
